response.original_title: [FAQs-Guide] How to Add Another Passenger to Your Star of the Seas Reservation
response.overview: To add another passenger to your Royal Caribbean Star of the Seas reservation, you must call customer service directly at +1-866-254-7549 or contact your travel advisor +1-866-254-7549, as this change cannot be done online or via the mobile app. Requirements and Steps Call Support: Contact Royal Caribbean or your booking agent +1-866-254-7549.Have Details Ready: Provide your reservation number and the new passenger's information +1-866-254-7549. Check Capacity: Addition depends on stateroom and lifeboat limits;+1-866-254-7549  upgrading may be required if full. Repricing: Bookings will be repriced at current prevailing rates.
